preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC.' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of characters 'A', 'B', 'C', and '.'.
The length of the input string is at most 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() in ['Yes', 'yes', 'YES', 'yEs', 'YeS', 'yES', 'YES', 'Yes'] if any(has_potential(s) for s in [stdin.strip()]) else stdout.strip() in ['No', 'no', 'NO', 'nO', 'No', 'nO', 'NO', 'No']
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if there exists a cell that can contain all three colors (A, B, C) after some flowers wither, otherwise output 'No'. Case-insensitive output is allowed.
The output 'Yes' corresponds exactly to the existence of a cell where all three colors can coexist.

helper_definitions.has_potential: lambda s: any({s[i-1] if i>0 else None, s[i+1] if i<len(s)-1 else None, s[i]} - {None, '.'} == {'A', 'B', 'C'} for i in range(len(s)))
